title: Earn AlFursan Miles with Alinma AlFursan Credit Cards | AlFursan Partners
desc: Earn up to 135,000+ Reward Miles with Alinma AlFursan credit cards. Start building toward your next holiday with Saudia today. Apply now and travel further!
h1: Earn AlFursan Miles with Alinma AlFursan Credit Cards | AlFursan Partners
html:
AlFursan Alinma Credit Cards

Take off with our new Alinma AlFursan credit cards, and enjoy up to 135,000+ Reward Miles and more to help you build towards your next holiday.

Build your Miles balance on the ground and earn up to 1 Reward Mile for every SAR 1.5 on local transactions, and up to 1 Reward Mile for every SAR 1 spent on international transactions.

Apply now

Additional benefits

  • Access to AlFursan lounges for Alinma "Infinite and Signature" cards "Terms and conditions apply".
  • Access to VIP lounges in more than 1,000 airports around the world with Alinma AlFursan Infinite and Signature card through Lounge Key website or 25 airports with Alinma AlFursan Platinum card through Dragon Pass website provided by VISA International Organization.
  • Exclusive discount up to 15% when using Alinma AlFursan credit card at SIXT car rental.
  • Get instant approval via the Alinma App based on average balance.
  • The possibility of transferring up to 30% of the credit card balance to the current account via Alinma Internet or cash withdrawal amounting to 30% of the credit card balance through Alinma ATMs.

Alinma AlFursan credit cards Platinum Signature Infinite
Welcome Bonus 5,000 Reward Miles on activation and SAR 1,000 spend within 90 days 25,000 Reward Miles on activation and SAR 1,000 spend within 90 days 45,000 Reward Miles on activation and SAR 1,000 spend within 90 days
Monthly Bonus Miles 1,500 AlFursan Reward Miles when spending 8,000 SAR monthly. 5,500 AlFursan Reward Miles when spending 10,000 SAR monthly. 7,500 AlFursan Reward Miles when spending 10,000 SAR monthly.
Earn on local spend 1 Reward Mile per 4 SAR 1 Reward Mile per 3 SAR 1 Reward Mile per 2.5 SAR
Earn on international spend 1 Reward Mile per 3 SAR 1 Reward Mile per 1.5 SAR 1 Reward Mile per 1 SAR
AlFursan Lounge Pass — 2 passes earned on SAR 30,000 International spend (Once per year) 2 passes earned on SAR 20,000 International spend (Twice per year)

*Total spend will be calculated on monthly basis and reset every month per monthly credit card statement cycle.

  • If all monthly bonuses are achieved during the year, and total purchase usage is above SAR 150,000, an extra one month of Bonus Miles applies according to product type.

For missing Miles please contact: 800-120-8000

Terms and conditions

  • Customer must activate and perform transactions within 90 days with minimum total amounts 1,000 SAR, to receive the Welcome Miles offer.
  • The Welcome Miles offer applies to the first card requested by the client. The client will not be eligible if the card is re-issued or if a replacement card is requested after three (3) months following the date of issuing the first card.
  • The bank shall have the right to take necessary measures to protect its rights in the event of misusing the offer.
  • Credit card status must be active to receive Miles.
  • Alinma Bank has the right to update terms and conditions and notify customers 30 days before any changes.
  • Miles calculation related to welcome, monthly and annual rewards shall not apply to the following transactions:
    • Cash withdrawal.
    • Fees and Annual profit rate.
    • Bill payment through the bank.
    • Replenishment of electronic wallets.
    • Refund of purchase transactions.
    • Transactions not entered in the card account statement.
    • Transactions for commercial usage.
  • Alinma Bank and AlFursan terms and conditions are applied.
